PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>

SELECT ?deathPlace
WHERE {
  dbr:They_Only_Kill_Their_Masters dbo:director ?director .
  ?director dbp:deathPlace ?deathPlace .
}
LIMIT 100
